source: GRE高频词 + Word Power Made Easy体系

words.englishDef: A public speech or published text in praise of someone
words.example: The obituary was a panegyric to his achievements.
words.exampleTrans: 讣告是对他成就的颂扬。

words.englishDef: Sharp and forthright in tone; biting
words.example: Her acerbic wit made some people uncomfortable.
words.exampleTrans: 她尖刻的机智让一些人不舒服。

words.englishDef: To pacify or placate someone by agreeing to their demands
words.example: The government tried to appease the protesters.

words.englishDef: Having or showing great knowledge or learning
words.example: His erudite commentary impressed the academics.
words.exampleTrans: 他博学的评论给学者们留下了深刻印象。

words.englishDef: The ability to make good judgements and decisions quickly
words.example: She showed great business acumen in negotiations.
words.exampleTrans: 她在谈判中展现出卓越的商业头脑。

words.englishDef: Fond of the company of others; sociable
words.example: She was gregarious and loved meeting new people.
words.exampleTrans: 她爱社交，喜欢结识新朋友。

words.englishDef: Based on a mistaken belief; misleading
words.example: His argument was based on fallacious reasoning.
words.exampleTrans: 他的论点基于错误的推理。

words.englishDef: A remark or statement that is dull because it has been said too often
words.example: His speech was full of platitudes and offered nothing new.
words.exampleTrans: 他的演讲充满了陈词滥调，没有任何新意。

words.englishDef: Treating all rivals or disputants equally
words.example: A judge must be completely impartial.

words.englishDef: Expressing a particular point of view; not impartial
words.example: His tendentious article ignored the opposing evidence.
words.exampleTrans: 他带有倾向性的文章忽略了反面证据。
